provenance.fusion: SignalFusionEngine (LIOP/LLOP, core/fusion_logic.py) with WALK-FORWARD fitted calibration
provenance.note: R/T-8b did single-pass (inert calibration, cold-start identity). This grid performs a proper walk-forward fit so the swept params genuinely change the fused output.

honesty_note: Swept parameters are the FOUR genuinely tunable knobs inside the directional LIOP fusion path (isotonic y_min/y_max, MIN_SAMPLES, max_history, window_start) — verified in source. The calibration MODE axis (platt/bma/emos/both, ModulatorStack), hierarchical_bayes TIER_THRESHOLDS, and sample_floor shrinkage are REAL in code but on a DIFFERENT surface (post-fusion modulator / temperature-error °F calibration), NOT the directional strike-crossing score — sweeping them here would be a fabricated axis with no effect. Reported as such.
